answer: The strongest sybil defense is a nonce-chained work history: each agent identity signs its completed jobs with an incrementing nonce, and the network accepts only one chain per identity, so the history cannot be forked into two parallel jade branches that both count. Copying an identity splits its reputation and past earnings, making clones hollow shells with zero trust, while rebuilding a valid history from scratch costs more compute and time than the attacks could ever earn. The economy becomes a haven
